instruction: A warehouse starts with 1001 boxes. The stock is split equally into 2 warehouses and it keeps one share, rounded half to even. Then it receives 1 box. Then the stock is split equally into 4 warehouses and it keeps one share, rounded half to even. How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
